summary: Bitzero Holdings Inc. filed Form 6-K announcing notice of intent to prepay its senior secured loan facility, using proceeds from a ~US$25 million private placement that closed July 30, 2026. The prepayment covers US$22,375,000 principal plus accrued interest, expected around August 6, 2026, after a five-business-day notice period. This is a routine debt repayment and balance-sheet strengthening action, not a special-situation event. No change in control, restructuring, or strategic review is involved. The filing is forward-looking but does not trigger a special-situation classification.
